decisions.statement: Do not resample merely to reconcile labeled clips with each other; all read labeled clips are 16000 Hz.
No downmix is required to reconcile labeled clips. All read labeled clips are mono.

decisions.evidence: Every labeled class has the same count, so class weighting or oversampling is not justified by the label distribution. Validation and internal-test counts differ by at most one clip per class because 15 percent of 350 is not an integer. That is a split-rounding effect, not a class-imbalance problem.
decisions.statement: Do not use class weighting or oversampling because of label frequency.

decisions.evidence: 150 labeled clips reach a peak absolute amplitude of at least 32767. RMS varies across clips in the Phase 2 metadata. No normalization was fit.
decisions.statement: Peak or RMS scaling was not chosen.

decisions.evidence: A 25 ms frame stepping every 10 ms is low-energy when its RMS is strictly below 1 percent of that clip's maximum frame RMS. This is not a silence measurement.
decisions.statement: Low-energy proportions were measured. They were not shown to be silence, and no trim was applied.

decisions.evidence: Round windows 4, 5, 6, and 8 seconds, plus training-split percentile windows, are in fixed_window_impact.csv.
Shorter-than-window percentages are recorded. Padding values were not tested.
decisions.statement: Padding location and fill value are open.

decisions.evidence: Longer-than-window percentages and retained-duration percentages are recorded. No clip was cut.
decisions.statement: Whether to cut the start, the end, or another region is open.

decisions.evidence: Candidate settings are 13, 20, and 40 coefficients with a 25 ms window, 10 ms hop, 40 HTK-mel bands, and FFT length 512.
Delta features were computed for one clip and are feasible. They were not compared in a classifier.
Sequence storage at the median length is much larger than mean pooling. Accuracy was not measured.
decisions.statement: Mean pooling, mean and standard deviation, or a fixed-length sequence were not chosen.
